subject: design/worktracker-hierarchy-index
statement: the index is a directory of **empty marker files, one per edge**, under a parent-keyed shard: a child's membership under a parent is the *presence of its marker file*, carrying no data (`design-brainstorm:worktracker-hierarchy-query-tech-design#ALT-1`). A children query lists the parent's marker directory (bounded by k, the child count) and then reads each named child's authoritative item file; the rollup counts open ones from those reads. Empty markers mean the index can only ever *lag* membership, never hold a wrong value — the stale-value class of drift is structurally impossible, which is why decision-path re-verification (DINV-2) fully closes the correctness gap. The exact on-disk path layout (root, sharding, filename grammar) is in the solution-shape.
